title: Dynamic Watermarking Sequence
purpose: On-the-fly dynamic watermarking for photo content using sharp to composite a tiled @username SVG watermark, with temporary R2 upload and 60-second signed URL delivery
description: On-view watermarking pipeline: fan requests watermarked content via GET /api/v1/content/:id/watermarked. Content service first runs access control check (D-02 decision tree). If fan is creator, skip watermark and serve original. If photo + not creator, proceed with watermark: download original from R2 private via StorageService.downloadFromPrivate, build SVG overlay with @{fan.username} text (white, 25% opacity, tiled diagonally across image), composite via sharp(buffer).composite([{ input: svgBuffer, tile: true }]), convert result to WebP (quality 90), upload watermarked buffer to temp/wm-{fan.id}-{timestamp}.webp in R2 private (cache-control: max-age=300), generate 60-second signed URL via getPrivateSignedUrl, return signed URL or 302 redirect to the watermarked image. Security degradation: if ANY watermarking step fails, the original unwatermarked file is served instead.

actors.label: Fan (Content Viewer)
actors.description: Authenticated user requesting to view photo content

systems.label: Frontend
systems.description: React SPA requesting watermarked content URL

modules.label: Content Service
modules.description: createWatermarkedImage function and access control logic

externalSystems.label: Cloudflare R2
externalSystems.description: S3-compatible object storage for original and watermarked files

exitPoints.label: Watermarked Image Served
exitPoints.description: 60-second signed URL returned, image has @username watermark

exitPoints.label: Original Image Served (Creator)
exitPoints.description: Creator viewing own content — no watermark

exitPoints.label: 403 Access Denied
exitPoints.description: Fan does not meet access control requirements

exitPoints.label: Original Served (Watermark Failed)
exitPoints.description: Watermark process failed — original unwatermarked file served as fallback

preconditions: Fan is authenticated with valid JWT
Content exists, is published, and fan passes access control checks
Content type is image (only images are watermarked)
R2 private bucket is accessible for read and write
postconditions: Watermarked image uploaded to temp/wm-{fanId}-{timestamp}.webp in R2
Temp file persists in R2 with no automated cleanup (no TTL mechanism)
If watermarking fails, original unwatermarked file URL returned

nodes.label: GET /api/v1/content/:id/watermarked
nodes.description: Fan requests watermarked content view URL

nodes.label: Access Control Check (D-02)
nodes.description: Run full 9-decision access pipeline — ownership, subscription, tier, PPV checks

nodes.label: 403 Access Denied
nodes.description: Fan fails access control — subscription/tier/PPV requirements not met

nodes.label: Is Fan the Creator?
nodes.description: If fan.id === content.creator_id, skip watermark entirely

nodes.label: Serve Original (no watermark)
nodes.description: Creator gets original full-resolution file with no watermark

nodes.label: downloadFromPrivate(originalKey)
nodes.description: Download original image file from R2 private bucket via s3.GetObjectCommand

nodes.label: Download Failed Fallback
nodes.description: R2 download fails — serve original unwatermarked URL as security degradation

nodes.label: Build SVG Watermark Overlay
nodes.description: Construct SVG text element with @{fan.username}, white color, 25% opacity, tiled diagonally

nodes.label: sharp.composite SVG over Image
nodes.description: sharp(fileBuffer).composite([{ input: svgBuffer, tile: true }]) to overlay watermark

nodes.label: Convert to WebP (quality 90)
nodes.description: sharp output to WebP format at quality 90 for bandwidth optimization

nodes.label: Watermark Composite Failed
nodes.description: sharp error during composite — return original file (security degradation)

nodes.label: Upload to R2 temp/wm-{fanId}-{timestamp}.webp
nodes.description: Upload watermarked buffer to R2 private temp/ prefix with cache-control: max-age=300

nodes.label: Temp Upload Failed
nodes.description: R2 upload of watermarked file fails — serve original as fallback

nodes.label: getPrivateSignedUrl(tempKey, 60)
nodes.description: Generate 60-second signed URL for watermarked temp file via s3.getSignedUrl

nodes.label: Return Signed URL to Frontend
nodes.description: Return { signedUrl, contentType } or 302 redirect to watermarked image

errorPaths.recovery: Non-retriable — fallback degrades security but preserves access

validationRules.rule: Only image MIME types (startsWith 'image/') are watermarked
Fan must pass full access control before watermark is generated
Signed URL expiry: 60 seconds (vs 3600 for regular content)

businessRules.rule: Watermark text: @{fan.username} in white, 25% opacity, tiled diagonally
Security degradation: ALL watermark failures silently serve original unwatermarked file
Temp files in temp/ prefix are NEVER cleaned up — no TTL mechanism

securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: Security degradation fallback — if ANY watermark step fails, original unwatermarked file is served. An attacker could trigger watermark failure intentionally to bypass protection.
Temp files accumulate in R2 temp/ prefix indefinitely — no garbage collection or TTL
60-second signed URL is short-lived but a determined attacker could still capture the unwatermarked image during that window
Watermark is SVG text overlay — can be cropped, edited out, or removed by skilled user
CSS blur on locked content is cosmetic only — server never serves full content without access check (mitigated)
performanceConsiderations: Watermarking adds significant latency: R2 download + sharp composite + R2 upload + signed URL generation
Each watermark request generates a unique temp file per fan — no cache reuse between fans
60-second signed URL vs 3600-second for regular content — 60x more frequent URL generation for watermarked content
Sharp image processing is CPU and memory intensive for high-resolution images

annotations.text: Security degradation: if ANY watermarking step fails (sharp error, R2 download failure, upload failure), the original unwatermarked file is served instead
Temp files in temp/ prefix are never cleaned up — no TTL mechanism exists. Indefinite accumulation.
60-second signed URL for watermarked vs 3600-second for regular content — no documented reason for the discrepancy
Watermark: @{username} SVG text, white 25% opacity, tiled diagonally across image, output as WebP q90
